rationale: Contract inherited verbatim: ode_system with states [N, reproductive_adult_abundance], time symbol t, initial conditions N(0)=RA(0)=100. Parameter values chosen to be physically reasonable for an annual, seasonally forced vertebrate/insect-like population: mean_recruitment_rate=2/y with 50% annual and 20% second-harmonic modulation; mortality ~0.3-0.5/y; small crowding coefficients (5e-4) so density dependence bites only near carrying capacities of a few hundred; K_M=20, K_R=100 place mate limitation and recruitment-resource competition in the operating range of N~100. The new mechanism (a sharp von-Mises-like annual recruitment pulse) uses the hinted magnitudes: peak_recruitment_pulse_rate=3/y, kappa=5 (moderately narrow pulse), phase=pi/2. excitation_check confirms the new term drives dN/dt by ~60x the sigma=1 noise floor at t~7.36 y, well above the k=5 threshold. n_points=400 over 8 years (~50/year) resolves both harmonics and the sharp pulse.
